KYC KYC

Know Your Customer: identity and address verification required before you can invest.

हिंदी में: KYC

Know Your Customer: निवेश से पहले पहचान और पते की पुष्टि।

How it is used in the lessons

KYC (Know Your Customer): proof of identity and address, usually PAN and Aadhaar, a bank account, a photograph and a signature.

From Stock Market Foundations

KYC (Know Your Customer) is done once with your PAN, Aadhaar, bank details and a photo.
